finding.headline: "The First-Flight Mum"
finding.problem: "I'm flying solo with a baby for the first time to meet my parents. What if her ears hurt? What if she cries the whole way and people hate me?"
finding.person: Diaspora mum flying her 3-month baby to Nigeria for the naming ceremony / to meet grandparents; terrified of flight, germs, baby ear pain, and fellow-passenger glares.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Wings for Two: Your First Flight With Baby (Visa-Free Confidence)."". Verdict: PASSES.
